title: Confusion Matrix

plan.insight: Moving the decision threshold trades false positives for false negatives; class overlap sets how good any threshold can be.
plan.reacts: matrix counts, outcome shares, score densities with the threshold line, accuracy and F1

init: return { scores: range(120).map((i) => { const y = i % 2; return [round(sigmoid(randn(y ? state.sep / 2 : -state.sep / 2, 1)), 3), y]; }) };

components.label: Separation
components.onChange: return { sep: value, scores: range(120).map((i) => { const y = i % 2; return [round(sigmoid(randn(y ? value / 2 : -value / 2, 1)), 3), y]; }) };

components.label: New sample
components.onClick: return { scores: range(120).map((i) => { const y = i % 2; return [round(sigmoid(randn(y ? state.sep / 2 : -state.sep / 2, 1)), 3), y]; }) };

components.title: Confusion matrix
components.draw:
const c = (pred, act) => state.scores.filter((s) => (s[0] >= state.t ? 1 : 0) === pred && s[1] === act).length;
return [heatmap([[c(1, 1), c(0, 1)], [c(1, 0), c(0, 0)]], { showValues: true, min: 0, xLabels: ['Pred +', 'Pred -'], yLabels: ['Actual +', 'Actual -'] })];

components.title: Outcomes
components.draw:
const c = (pred, act) => state.scores.filter((s) => (s[0] >= state.t ? 1 : 0) === pred && s[1] === act).length;
return [pie([c(1, 1), c(0, 1), c(1, 0), c(0, 0)], { labels: ['TP', 'FN', 'FP', 'TN'], colors: ['green', 'orange', 'red', 'blue'], donut: 0.45 })];
